race_compiled_concurrent.projection: pool_makespan divided by probe cells, times pooled cells; no second efficiency divisor

serial_race_cells: ablation cells and offline continuations use the slowest single-task per-cell wall because those loops are serial in execute_phase6

builds.wall: slowest build times unique builds divided by 8 once

resamples.wall: slowest times charged resamples, serial coordinator loop, not divided by 8

wall_reserve: compare projected wall to 17280; do not multiply by 1.20 again
solo: recorded separately and not used as a divisor
